newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand pays tribute to Deng achievements.
newsitem.headline: Thailand pays tribute to Deng achievements.

text.p: Thailand said on Thursday the death of China's supreme leader Deng Xiaoping was a major loss for the world.
The late leader had contributed to close Sino-Thai relations as well as to peace and stability in Southeast Asia, a government statement said.
Initiatives balancing socialist and free market policies were responsible for China's double-digit economic growth in recent years, it added.
Thailand also praised Deng for smooth Sino-British talks on the Hong Kong transition under his "one country, two systems" policy.
Commerce Minister Narongchai Akrasanee told reporters separately that Deng's death on Wednesday would not have any impact on Thai-China economic relations.
"I dont think there will be any impact (on economic matters). His responsibilities had already been passed on to others in China for a long time. It will have only a moral impact," he said.
